pages_checked.scope: Read the sole PR's title, body and all four file patches from the GitHub REST API. The file inventory fit on one 100-file page.

exclusions.title: Pin GitHub Actions and enforce immutable references
exclusions.reason: The PR pinned six action references in deploy.yml and update-data.yml, added a zizmor workflow for the unpinned-uses rule, and configured grouped Dependabot updates. The negative and positive probes described in the body validate the pinning rule. All four patches concern workflow security or dependency maintenance.

limitations: The PR's reported pinning probes were not independently rerun.
